# write_blocking_spheres_file { #mofography.raspa_helper.write_blocking_spheres_file }

```python
raspa_helper.write_blocking_spheres_file(path, spheres)
```

Write RASPA-style blocking list: first line = count, then ``sx sy sz r``
per line (fractional coordinates, radius in Å).



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

path : str or pathlib.Path
spheres : sequence of (sx, sy, sz, r)
